translations.literal: Examining the established practices of the ancestors, in Huangyou total revenue was thirty-nine million, yet expenditures were only one-third of that;
translations.idiomatic: Examining the precedents of our forefathers, under Huangyou total revenue reached thirty-nine million, yet spending consumed only a third;

sentences.zh: 治平四千四百萬，而費五之一；

translations.literal: in Zhiping forty-four million, yet expenditures were one-fifth;
translations.idiomatic: under Zhiping it was forty-four million, yet spending took only a fifth;

sentences.zh: 熙寧五千六十萬，而費盡之。

translations.literal: in Xining fifty million six hundred thousand, yet expenditures consumed it all.
translations.idiomatic: under Xining it was fifty million six hundred thousand, and spending consumed every bit.

sentences.zh: 今諸道隨一月所須，旋為裒會，汲汲然不能終日。

translations.literal: Now each circuit calculates what is needed month by month and immediately assembles funds — in desperate haste, unable to last a full day.
translations.idiomatic: Now each circuit tallies its monthly needs and scrambles to assemble funds — in such desperate haste that supplies cannot last a single day.

sentences.zh: 願深裁浮冗，以寬用度。

translations.literal: I pray that you deeply cut superfluous expenditures to ease fiscal strain.
translations.idiomatic: I pray that Your Majesty deeply cut wasteful excess to relieve the strain on the treasury.

sentences.zh: 」屬疾祈外，加龍圖閣學士、知潤州，卒於道，年六十六。

translations.literal: Due to illness he requested an outside post, was given Academician in the Hall of Dragon Designs and made prefect of Runzhou; he died on the road at sixty-six.
translations.idiomatic: Falling ill, he requested an outside appointment, was made Academician in the Hall of Dragon Designs and prefect of Runzhou, and died on the road at sixty-six.

sentences.zh: 贈左正議大夫。

translations.literal: Posthumously awarded Grand Master of Left Remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted the title Grand Master of Left Remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 策在元祐、紹聖時，皆居言職。

translations.literal: Ce during both Yuanyou and Shaosheng held remonstrance posts.
translations.idiomatic: Ce held remonstrance posts during both the Yuanyou and Shaosheng eras.

sentences.zh: 雖不依人取進，亦頗持兩端，故黨議之興，己獨得免。

translations.literal: Though he did not advance by relying on others, he also tended to straddle both sides — thus when factional disputes arose, he alone escaped harm.
translations.idiomatic: Though he did not advance by currying favor, he also tended to sit on the fence, and so when factional strife erupted he alone escaped unscathed.

sentences.zh: 弟奕。

translations.literal: His younger brother was Yi.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother was Yi.

sentences.zh: 弟 奕

translations.literal: Yi
translations.idiomatic: Yi

sentences.zh: 奕，字純臣。

translations.literal: Yi, styled Puren.
translations.idiomatic: Yi, courtesy name Puren.

sentences.zh: 第進士。

translations.literal: He placed in the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 崇寧，提舉河北西路常平，洺、相饑，徙之東路。

translations.literal: In Chongning he served as Intendant of Changping on the Western Route of Hebei; when Mozhou and Xiangzhou suffered famine, he was transferred to the Eastern Route.
translations.idiomatic: In the Chongning era he served as Intendant of the Ever-Normal Granaries on the Western Route of Hebei. When Mozhou and Xiangzhou suffered famine, he was transferred to the Eastern Route.

sentences.zh: 入對，徽宗問行期，對曰：「臣退即行，流民不以時還，則來歲耕桑皆廢矣。

translations.literal: At audience with the emperor, Huizong asked when he would depart; he replied: "Your servant will depart immediately upon withdrawal — if displaced people are not returned in time, next year's farming and sericulture will all be ruined."
translations.idiomatic: At audience Huizong asked when he would depart. Yi replied, "Your servant will leave the moment this audience ends. If displaced people are not returned in time, next year's planting and mulberry cultivation will all be lost."

sentences.zh: 」帝悅。

translations.literal: The emperor was pleased.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was pleased.

sentences.zh: 既而西部盜起，復徙提點刑獄。

translations.literal: Soon bandits arose in the western region; he was again transferred as Judicial Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: Soon bandits rose in the western region, and he was again transferred as Judicial Intendant.

sentences.zh: 時朝廷將遣兵逐捕，奕條上方略，請罷勿用，而自計討賊，不閱月可定。

translations.literal: The court was about to dispatch troops to pursue them; Yi submitted a strategic plan, requesting that this be abandoned, and pledged to suppress the bandits himself — within a month it could be settled.
translations.idiomatic: The court was about to dispatch troops to hunt them down. Yi submitted a plan urging that course be abandoned, pledging to suppress the bandits himself within a month.

sentences.zh: 轉運使張摶以為不可，宰相主摶策，數月不效，卒用奕議，悉降之。

translations.literal: Transport Commissioner Zhang Bo thought it impossible; the chancellor backed Bo's plan — after months without success, they finally adopted Yi's proposal and all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Transport Commissioner Zhang Bo thought it impossible, and the chancellor backed Bo's approach. After months without result, they finally adopted Yi's plan and all the bandits surrendered.

sentences.zh: 擢監察御史。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Investigating Censor.

sentences.zh: 親祭北郊，燕人趙良嗣為秘書丞侍祠，奕白其長曰：「今親衛不用三路人，而良嗣以外國降子，顧得預祠事，可乎？

translations.literal: At the emperor's personal sacrifice at the Northern Suburbs, the Yan native Zhao Liangsi served as Secretary Attendant at the rites; Yi told his superior: "The imperial guard now does not use men from the Three Routes — yet Liangsi, a surrendered son of a foreign state, is allowed to participate in the sacrifice — is this permissible?"
translations.idiomatic: At the emperor's personal sacrifice at the Northern Suburbs, the Yan native Zhao Liangsi served as Secretary Attendant at the rites. Yi told his superior, "The imperial guard no longer employs men from the Three Routes, yet Liangsi — a surrendered subject from a foreign state — is allowed to take part in the sacrifice. Is that proper?"

sentences.zh: 」長用其言，具以請，不報。

translations.literal: His superior accepted his view and submitted the request in full — no response was given.
translations.idiomatic: His superior accepted his argument and submitted a full request, but received no reply.

sentences.zh: 陽武民傭於富家，其室美，富子欲私之，弗得，怒殺之，而賂其夫使勿言。

translations.literal: A man of Yangwu was hired out to a wealthy family; his wife was beautiful; the rich man's son wanted her for himself but failed; in anger he killed her and bribed her husband to keep silent.
translations.idiomatic: A man of Yangwu was hired out to a wealthy household. His wife was beautiful, and the rich man's son sought to seduce her but failed. In rage he killed her and bribed her husband to say nothing.

sentences.zh: 事覺，府縣及大理鬻獄，奕受詔鞫訊，皆伏辜。

translations.literal: When the matter came to light, the prefecture, county, and Grand Court of Justice sold justice; Yi received orders to investigate — all confessed guilt.
translations.idiomatic: When the crime came to light, the prefecture, county, and Grand Court of Justice had corrupted the case. Yi received orders to investigate, and all the guilty confessed.

sentences.zh: 坐漏泄語言罷去。

translations.literal: Punished for leaking confidential matters, he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Punished for leaking confidential information, he was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 再逾年，還故職，提點河北刑獄。

translations.literal: After another year he was restored to his former post as Judicial Intendant of Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: After another year he was restored to his former post as Judicial Intendant of Hebei.

sentences.zh: 自何承矩創邊地為塘濼，有定界。

translations.literal: Since He Chengjiao created the border pond-marshes, there were fixed boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: Since He Chengjiao had created the frontier pond-marshes, fixed boundaries had been established.

sentences.zh: 既中貴人典領，以屯田開拓為功，肆侵民田，民上訴，屢出使者按治，皆不敢與直。

translations.literal: Once eunuchs took charge, treating frontier land reclamation as merit, they wantonly encroached on civilian fields; the people appealed upward — envoys were repeatedly sent to investigate, yet none dared set things right.
translations.idiomatic: Once eunuchs took charge and treated frontier land reclamation as a path to merit, they wantonly seized civilian fields. The people appealed upward, and envoys were repeatedly dispatched to investigate, yet none dared give them justice.

sentences.zh: 奕曲折上之，疏其五不可，詔罷屯田。

translations.literal: Yi presented the matter through indirect channels, detailing five reasons why it should not continue; an edict abolished the reclamation office.
translations.idiomatic: Yi memorialized through circuitous channels, setting forth five reasons the practice should stop. An edict abolished the reclamation office.

sentences.zh: 加直秘閣、淮南轉運副使。

translations.literal: He was given Direct access to the Secret Archive and made Vice Transport Commissioner of Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted Direct access to the Secret Archive and appointed Vice Transport Commissioner of Huainan.

sentences.zh: 入為開封少尹。

translations.literal: He entered court as Vice Magistrate of Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as Vice Magistrate of Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 故時大理、開封治獄，得請實蔽罪，其後率任情棄法，法益不用。

translations.literal: In former times the Grand Court and Kaifeng handled cases with requests to reduce sentences that concealed crimes; afterward they routinely indulged whim and abandoned law — the law was used less and less.
translations.idiomatic: In former times the Grand Court and Kaifeng handled cases with sentence-reduction requests that concealed crimes. Later they routinely indulged personal whim and abandoned the law, and the law fell increasingly into disuse.

sentences.zh: 奕言：「廷尉持天下平，京師諸夏本，法且不行，何以示萬國。

translations.literal: Yi said: "The Chief Justice holds the scales of empire; the capital is the root of all under Heaven — if the law is not enforced here, how can it be shown to the myriad states?"
translations.idiomatic: Yi said, "The Chief Justice holds the scales of the empire. The capital is the root of all under Heaven. If the law is not enforced here, how can we show it to the myriad states?"

sentences.zh: 請自今非情法實不相當，毋得輒請。

translations.literal: I request that from now on, where circumstance and law do not truly correspond, no request for leniency be permitted.
translations.idiomatic: I request that from now on, where circumstances and the law do not truly align, no leniency request be permitted.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 遷光祿卿、戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Director of Imperial Entertainments and Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Director of Imperial Entertainments and Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 睦州亂，以龍圖閣直學士知鎮江府。

translations.literal: When Muzhou rebelled, he was made Academician in the Hall of Dragon Designs and prefect of Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: When Muzhou rose in rebellion, he was made Academician in the Hall of Dragon Designs and prefect of Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 寇平，論勞增兩秩。

translations.literal: When the rebels were pacified, his merit was counted and his rank increased by two steps.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels were pacified, his merit was recognized with a two-step increase in rank.

sentences.zh: 還為戶部。

translations.literal: He returned to the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 內侍總領內藏，予奪顓己，視戶部如僚屬。

translations.literal: A eunuch superintendent controlled the Inner Treasury, granting and withholding at his sole discretion, treating the Ministry of Revenue like subordinate staff.
translations.idiomatic: A eunuch superintendent controlled the Inner Treasury, granting and withholding funds at his sole discretion and treating the Ministry of Revenue like his subordinates.

sentences.zh: 度支郎方討理滯，奉中旨，令開封尹與總領者來。

translations.literal: When the Revenue Section Director was investigating stalled accounts, by secret imperial order the Kaifeng Magistrate and the superintendent were summoned.
translations.idiomatic: While the Revenue Section Director was investigating stalled accounts, a secret imperial order summoned the Kaifeng Magistrate and the superintendent to attend.

sentences.zh: 奕白宰相曰：「計臣不才，當去之而易能者，不可使他人侵其官。

translations.literal: Yi told the chancellor: "As revenue minister I am incompetent — I should be replaced with someone capable — but others must not be allowed to encroach on my office."
translations.idiomatic: Yi told the chancellor, "As minister of revenue I am incompetent and should be replaced by someone capable — but others must not be allowed to encroach on my office."

sentences.zh: 」即自劾不稱職。

translations.literal: He immediately impeached himself as unfit for office.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately submitted a self-impeachment for incompetence.

sentences.zh: 詔為罷內侍，而徙奕工部。

translations.literal: An edict dismissed the eunuch and transferred Yi to the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: An edict dismissed the eunuch and transferred Yi to the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 襲慶守張漴使郡人詣闕請登封，東平守王靚諫以京東歲凶多盜，不當請封。

translations.literal: Zhang Chong, prefect of Xiqing, had county people go to court requesting a fengshan sacrifice; Wang Jing, prefect of Dongping, remonstrated that eastern capital circuits had famine years and many bandits — a feng request was inappropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Chong, prefect of Xiqing, sent county people to court to request a fengshan sacrifice. Wang Jing, prefect of Dongping, remonstrated that the eastern capital circuits had suffered famine years and rampant banditry, and that a feng request was inappropriate.

sentences.zh: 為政者不悅，將罪靚，奕言：「靚憂民愛君，所當獎激，奈何用為罪乎？

translations.literal: Those in power were displeased and were about to punish Jing; Yi said: "Jing cares for the people and loves his lord — he should be rewarded and encouraged — how can he be punished?"
translations.idiomatic: Those in power were displeased and were about to punish Jing. Yi said, "Jing cares for the people and loves his lord — he should be rewarded and encouraged. How can he be punished?"

sentences.zh: 」靚獲免。

translations.literal: Jing was spared.
translations.idiomatic: Jing was spared punishment.

sentences.zh: 未幾卒，年六十，贈龍圖閣學士。

translations.literal: Before long he died at sixty; posthumously awarded Academician in the Hall of Dragon Designs.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he died at sixty and was posthumously granted the title Academician in the Hall of Dragon Designs.

sentences.zh: 郭知章

translations.literal: Guo Zhizhang
translations.idiomatic: Guo Zhizhang

sentences.zh: 郭知章，字明叔，吉州龍泉人。

translations.literal: Guo Zhizhang, styled Mingshu, was a native of Longquan in Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Zhizhang, courtesy name Mingshu, came from Longquan in Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 第進士，從劉彝廣西幕府，知浮梁、分寧縣。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination, followed Liu Yi in the Guangxi staff, and governed Fuliang and Fenning counties.
translations.idiomatic: Having passed the jinshi examination, he served on Liu Yi's staff in Guangxi and was magistrate of Fuliang and Fenning counties.

sentences.zh: 黃履薦為御史，以憂不克拜，知海州、濮州，提點梓州路刑獄。

translations.literal: Huang Lü recommended him as censor, but because of mourning he could not take the post; he governed Haizhou and Puzhou and was Judicial Intendant of Zizhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Lü recommended him for the censorate, but bereavement kept him from taking the appointment. He served as prefect of Haizhou and Puzhou and as Judicial Intendant of Zizhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 復以鄭雍、顧臨薦，為監察御史。

translations.literal: Again through recommendation by Zheng Yong and Gu Lin, he became Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Recommended again by Zheng Yong and Gu Lin, he was appointed Investigating Censor.

sentences.zh: 哲宗親政，上書請用淳化、天禧詔增諫官員，曰：「館職無所用，朝廷設之不疑；

translations.literal: When Emperor Zhezong personally took up government, he submitted a memorial asking that the edicts of the Chunhua and Tianxi reigns be applied to increase remonstrance officials, saying: "Academy posts serve no use, yet the court establishes them without hesitation;"
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhezong personally assumed the reins of government, Zhizhang memorialized the throne, asking that the court follow the Chunhua and Tianxi precedents and increase the number of remonstrance officials. He wrote, "Court academy posts serve little purpose, yet the throne creates them without a second thought;

sentences.zh: 諫官最急，乃常不足。

translations.literal: remonstrance officials are most urgent, yet are constantly insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: remonstrance officials are the most urgent need, yet their ranks are perpetually too thin.

sentences.zh: 是急於所無用，緩其所當急也。

translations.literal: This is to hurry what is useless and to slacken what ought to be urgent.
translations.idiomatic: This is to rush what is useless and to neglect what ought to be urgent.

sentences.zh: 又比歲選授監司，多繇寺監丞，不過知縣資序。

translations.literal: Moreover, in recent years in selecting and appointing circuit commissioners, many come from directorate and agency vice-directors, with no more than county-magistrate seniority.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, in recent years circuit commissioners have often been drawn from directorate and agency vice-directors, men whose qualifications rise no higher than county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 外官莫重於部使者，豈宜輕用若是？

translations.literal: Among outer officials none is weightier than the circuit envoy—how can they be lightly used like this?
translations.idiomatic: Among field officials none carries greater weight than the circuit envoy. How can such posts be filled so lightly?

sentences.zh: 宜稍限以節。

translations.literal: They should be somewhat restricted to keep measure.
translations.idiomatic: Some restraint ought to be imposed to restore proper limits.

sentences.zh: 如轉運判官擇實任通判者，提點刑獄擇實任郡守者，然後考其治理，簡拔用之。

translations.literal: For example, let transport deputy commissioners be chosen from those who have truly served as military prefects, and judicial intendants from those who have truly served as prefects; then examine their governance and select the outstanding for appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Transport deputy commissioners should be chosen from men who have genuinely served as military prefects, and judicial intendants from men who have genuinely governed prefectures. Only then should their record in office be examined and the able among them selected for promotion.

sentences.zh: 」又言：「自大河東、北分流，生靈被害。

translations.literal: " He also said: "Since the Great River split east and north, the people have suffered harm.
translations.idiomatic: " He also wrote, "Since the Yellow River split to the east and north, the people have suffered grievously.

sentences.zh: 今水之趨東者已不可遏，順而導之，閉北而行東，其利百倍矣。」

translations.literal: Now the water's rush eastward can no longer be checked; if we follow and guide it, close the north and send it east, the benefit will be a hundredfold."
translations.idiomatic: The river's eastward course can no longer be checked. If we follow its tendency and guide it—closing the northern channel and sending the flow east—the benefit would be a hundredfold."

sentences.zh: 遷殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Palace Censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Palace Censor.

sentences.zh: 言：「先帝辟地進壤，建策四砦，據 臨下，扼西戎咽喉。

translations.literal: He said: "The former emperor expanded territory and gained soil, built and planned four fortresses, perched overlooking below, and choked the throat of the Western Rong.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized, "The former emperor expanded the frontier and gained territory, established four strategic fortresses, and held commanding ground overlooking the passes below, seizing the throat of the Western Rong.

sentences.zh: 元祐用事者委而棄之，願討賾議奏，顯行黜罰。

translations.literal: The Yuanyou faction in power abandoned and cast them away; I wish to investigate thoroughly, memorialize, and openly carry out demotions and punishments.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuanyou faction in power cast them aside and abandoned them. I ask that the matter be thoroughly investigated and memorialized, and that demotions and punishments be openly imposed.

sentences.zh: 」史院究《神宗實籙》誣罔事，知章請貶治呂大防等。

translations.literal: " The History Academy investigated the matter of deception in the Veritable Records of Emperor Shenzong, and Zhizhang requested demotion and punishment of Lü Dafang and others.
translations.idiomatic: " The History Academy investigated the falsehoods in the Veritable Records of Emperor Shenzong, and Zhizhang asked that Lü Dafang and others be demoted and punished.

sentences.zh: 紹聖復制科，知章校試，言：「先朝既策進士，即廢此科，近年復置，誠無所補。

translations.literal: In Shaosheng the special examination was restored; Zhizhang supervised the test and said: "The previous court, having examined jinshi by policy essay, then abolished this examination; in recent years it was restored, but truly it adds nothing.
translations.idiomatic: When Shaosheng restored the special examination, Zhizhang supervised the test and wrote, "Once the previous court had examined jinshi by policy essay, it abolished this examination. Restoring it in recent years truly adds nothing.

sentences.zh: 」遂復罷。

translations.literal: " It was then abolished again.
translations.idiomatic: " The examination was abolished once more.

sentences.zh: 又請復元豐役法，大抵迎合時好。

translations.literal: He also asked to restore the Yuanfeng corvée law; on the whole he catered to the tastes of the time.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that the Yuanfeng corvée law be restored. In general, his proposals catered to the prevailing mood of the court.

sentences.zh: 進左司員外郎，改左司諫。

translations.literal: He advanced to Left Secretariat Vice Director and was changed to Left Remonstrance Official.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Left Secretariat Vice Director and then transferred to Left Remonstrance Official.

sentences.zh: 嘗言：「爵祿慶賞，以勸天下之善，願無以假借大臣，使行私恩；

translations.literal: He once said: "Ranks, stipends, honors, and rewards are to encourage goodness throughout the realm; I wish they not be lent to great ministers to let them dispense private favor;
translations.idiomatic: He once wrote, "Ranks, stipends, honors, and rewards exist to encourage virtue throughout the realm. I ask that they not be lent to great ministers as instruments of private favor;

sentences.zh: 刑罰誅戮，以懲天下之惡，願無以假借大臣，使快私忿。

translations.literal: punishments, penalties, and executions are to chastise evil throughout the realm; I wish they not be lent to great ministers to let them vent private resentment.
translations.idiomatic: punishments, penalties, and executions exist to chastise evil throughout the realm. I ask that they not be lent to great ministers as instruments of private vengeance.

sentences.zh: 忠於陛下者，必見忌大臣；

translations.literal: Those loyal to Your Majesty will certainly be resented by great ministers;
translations.idiomatic: Those loyal to Your Majesty will inevitably be resented by great ministers;

sentences.zh: 黨於大臣者，必上負陛下。

translations.literal: those who attach themselves to great ministers will certainly fail Your Majesty above.
translations.idiomatic: those who attach themselves to great ministers will inevitably fail Your Majesty in turn.

sentences.zh: 惟明主財察。

translations.literal: Only an enlightened sovereign can investigate and discern.
translations.idiomatic: Only an enlightened sovereign can see this clearly.

sentences.zh: 」權工部侍郎，為中書舍人。

translations.literal: " He was acting Vice Minister of Works and became Drafting Officer of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: " He served as Acting Vice Minister of Works and was appointed Drafting Officer of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 遼使蕭德崇來為夏人請還河西地，命知章報聘。

translations.literal: The Liao envoy Xiao Dechong came to ask on the Xia people's behalf for the return of Hexi territory; Zhizhang was ordered to return the visit.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao envoy Xiao Dechong came to ask, on behalf of the Xia, that Hexi territory be returned. Zhizhang was ordered to go on a return mission.

sentences.zh: 德崇曰：「兩朝久通好，小國蕞爾疆土，還之可乎？

translations.literal: Dechong said: "Our two courts have long been at peace; our small state's tiny territory—can it be returned?
translations.idiomatic: Dechong said, "Our two courts have long been at peace. For our small state's tiny territory—might it be returned?

sentences.zh: 」知章曰：「夏人累犯邊，法當致討，以北朝勸和之故，務為優容。

translations.literal: " Zhizhang said: "The Xia people have repeatedly violated the border; by law they ought to be punished, but because the Northern Court urged peace, we have treated them with forbearance.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhizhang replied, "The Xia have repeatedly violated the frontier. By law they ought to be punished, but because the Northern Court urged peace, we have treated them with forbearance.

sentences.zh: 彼若恭順如初，當自有恩旨，非使人所能預知也。

translations.literal: If they are obedient as at first, imperial grace will naturally follow; this is not something an envoy can foreknow.
translations.idiomatic: If they are obedient as before, imperial grace will follow in due course. That is not something an envoy can presume to foretell.

sentences.zh: 」歸未至，坐嘗主導河東流議，以集賢殿修撰知和州。

translations.literal: " Before he returned, he was punished for having once advocated channeling the river eastward, and was made Academician-Compiler in the Hall of Assembled Worthies and prefect of Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: " Before he reached home, he was punished for having once advocated channeling the Yellow River eastward. He was made Academician-Compiler in the Hall of Assembled Worthies and prefect of Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 徽宗立，曾布用為工部侍郎，加寶文閣直學士、知太原府。

translations.literal: When Huizong ascended, Zeng Bu employed him as Vice Minister of Works, with added Direct Academician in the Hall of Precious Culture and prefect of Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: When Huizong ascended the throne, Zeng Bu appointed him Vice Minister of Works, with the added titles of Direct Academician in the Hall of Precious Culture and prefect of Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 召拜刑部尚書、知開封府，為翰林學士。

translations.literal: He was summoned, appointed Minister of Justice and prefect of Kaifeng, and made Hanlin Academician.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned to court as Minister of Justice and prefect of Kaifeng, and appointed Hanlin Academician.

sentences.zh: 言者又論河事，罷知鄧州，旋入黨籍。

translations.literal: Critics again raised the river affair; he was dismissed to govern Dengzhou and soon entered the faction register.
translations.idiomatic: Critics again attacked him over the river policy. He was dismissed to serve as prefect of Dengzhou and soon was entered on the faction register.

sentences.zh: 數年，復顯謨閣直學士。

translations.literal: After several years he was restored as Direct Academician in the Hall for Exalted Planning.
translations.idiomatic: Several years later he was restored to Direct Academician in the Hall for Exalted Planning.

sentences.zh: 政和初，卒。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhenghe, he died.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Zhenghe reign, he died.

sentences.zh: 論曰：神宗好大喜功之資，王安石、呂惠卿出而與之遇合，流毒不能止也。

translations.literal: Commentary: Emperor Shenzong had the character to love grandeur and merit; Wang Anshi and Lü Huiqing emerged and met with his favor—the poison spread and could not be stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: Emperor Shenzong had a temperament inclined toward grandeur and great deeds. When Wang Anshi and Lü Huiqing emerged and found favor with him, the poison spread and could not be checked.

sentences.zh: 哲、徽之世，一變而為蔡確、章惇、曾布，又變而為蔡京、蔡卞，日有甚之，而天下亡矣。

translations.literal: In the eras of Zhezong and Huizong, it changed once to Cai Que, Zhang Dun, and Zeng Bu, changed again to Cai Jing and Cai Bian—daily growing worse—and the empire was lost.
translations.idiomatic: In the reigns of Zhezong and Huizong, power passed first to Cai Que, Zhang Dun, and Zeng Bu, then to Cai Jing and Cai Bian. Day by day the evil deepened, until the empire was lost.

sentences.zh: 乘時起而附之者甚眾，若崔台符、楊汲以獄殺民；

translations.literal: Many rose with the times and attached themselves—such as Cui Taifu and Yang Ji, who killed people through lawsuits;
translations.idiomatic: Many rose with the times and attached themselves to power—Cui Taifu and Yang Ji, who killed people through lawsuits;

sentences.zh: 呂嘉問以均輸困民；

translations.literal: Lü Jiawen, who burdened the people with equalized transport;
translations.idiomatic: Lü Jiawen, who burdened the people with equalized transport;

sentences.zh: 董必肆酷，欲害流人以取悅；

translations.literal: Dong Bi, who wantonly cruel, wished to harm exiles to win favor;
translations.idiomatic: Dong Bi, who indulged in cruelty and sought to harm exiles in order to please his superiors;

sentences.zh: 李南公以反覆詭隨；

translations.literal: Li Nangong, with shifting duplicity;
translations.idiomatic: Li Nangong, with his shifting and opportunistic ways;

sentences.zh: 虞策以心持兩端；

translations.literal: Yu Ce, who held two hearts;
translations.idiomatic: Yu Ce, who kept a foot in both camps;

sentences.zh: 郭知章迎合時好，且發實錄之誣。

translations.literal: Guo Zhizhang catered to the tastes of the time and moreover exposed the deception in the Veritable Records.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Zhizhang catered to the tastes of the time and moreover exposed the falsehoods in the Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 觀諸人所學與其從政，已多可尚，何樂而為此惡哉？

translations.literal: Looking at what these men studied and how they governed, much was already admirable—why take pleasure in such evil?
translations.idiomatic: Judging by what these men had studied and how they had governed, much in them was already admirable. Why then did they take pleasure in such wickedness?

sentences.zh: 不過視一時君相之好尚，將以取富貴而已。

translations.literal: Nothing but reading the preferences of the ruler and minister of the moment, intending only to obtain wealth and honor.
translations.idiomatic: They did nothing but read the preferences of the ruler and chief minister of the moment, seeking wealth and rank and nothing more.

sentences.zh: 設使神宗如仁宗之治，哲、徽承之，必無紹述之禍，雖安石輩亦將有所薰陶，而未必肆其情以至是，況此諸人乎？

translations.literal: If Shenzong had ruled like Renzong, and Zhezong and Huizong had inherited that, there would certainly have been no calamity of "continuation"; even Wang Anshi and his kind would have been molded by it and might not have indulged their inclinations to such a degree—much less these men.
translations.idiomatic: Had Shenzong ruled as Renzong had, and had Zhezong and Huizong inherited that example, there would have been no calamity of "continuation." Even men like Wang Anshi would have been shaped by such an example and might not have indulged their inclinations so far—much less these lesser figures.

sentences.zh: 世道汙隆，士習升降，係於人主一念慮之趣向，可不戒哉！

translations.literal: Whether the age's ways sink or rise, whether scholar-official habits fall or ascend, depends on the direction of the sovereign's single thought—should this not be guarded against!
translations.idiomatic: Whether the age's moral tide ebbs or flows, whether the habits of the scholar-official class rise or fall—all this hangs on the direction of a single thought in the sovereign's mind. Should this not give us pause!

sentences.zh: 可不懼哉！

translations.literal: Should this not be feared!
translations.idiomatic: Should this not give us dread!
